manaNeeded: {B}{R} PLUS ENOUGH MANA TO PAY FOR COMMANDER TAX, IF APPLICABLE
description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix, causing target player to mill two cards.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, causing target player to mill two cards.
Cast Garna by paying {1}{B}{R}.
Garna enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
In response, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Garna, causing target player to mill three cards.
Resolve Garna's ability, returning Garna, Priest of Gix, Priest of Urabrask, and any other creature cards that were put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
